artifact_type: Portable publication inventory, not a replacement for the immutable freeze manifest

protocol.retrieval_relevance: Relevant chunks of the specific reference PDF only, in both scoped and cross-leaflet retrieval. Equivalent other-PDF evidence is not target retrieval success.
protocol.cross_leaflet_search: Corresponding frozen corpus, without hidden target-document filtering; retain non-target positions in the ranking.
protocol.recall: Recall@10 = retrieved annotated target-PDF gold chunks / all annotated target-PDF gold chunks; positives only.
protocol.mrr: First relevant target-PDF chunk reciprocal rank, retaining the existing evaluation ranking/cutoff convention. This release does not redefine its cutoff; record the inherited convention in the later experiment manifest.
protocol.negative_abstention: Evaluate the 200 negatives per reference leaflet only. Cross-leaflet variants do not establish unsupported queries over the whole corpus.
protocol.multi_fragment_limits: Recall@10 and MRR do not guarantee complete evidentiary coverage, interpretation or a faithful answer. Assess response fidelity separately.
protocol.answer_fidelity: Required requested information and indispensable qualifiers differ from optional complementary context. Correct answers are not penalized for omitting unrequested complementary details; included factual claims still require documentary support.
protocol.main_evaluation: Preserve dense/BM25/hybrid comparisons, target retrieval Recall@10/MRR, separate documentary fidelity, readability and operational indicators. No new metric or judge implementation.
protocol.pipeline_parameters: Unchanged; this is a documentary collection freeze, not a new pipeline/configuration freeze.

limitations: No individual human approval of all 1,000 records.
Human inspection was sampled and excerpt-based; AI-assisted full-PDF checks remain separately attributed.
Automated citation/hash checks establish mechanical traceability, not independent semantic validation or table interpretation.
Existing authored draft/pending metadata and historical not-frozen notices remain immutable; this release supplies separate collection-level acceptance.
No chunk IDs are mapped by this release; expected_chunk_ids remain unchanged.

pdfs.medication: fosfato de sitagliptina + cloridrato de metformina
